report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with 78-203ms latency; no 5xx, errors, or dependency failures are present in current evidence. The alert shows no clear fault, so no root-cause candidate is substantiated. Need downstream dependency metrics/logs and a latency baseline to determine whether any degradation exists.

Gateway-to-order client latency breakdown vs order internal processing time
Error/timeout logs from order and its dependencies during the window
Baseline latency SLO/threshold to judge whether 78-203ms checkout is anomalous
